# Browser libraries

The browser distributions in this directory are served locally. Do not replace them with unversioned remote scripts.

- DOMPurify 3.4.17: https://github.com/cure53/DOMPurify (DOMPurify-LICENSE)
- PDF.js 4.10.38: https://github.com/mozilla/pdf.js (PDFjs-LICENSE)
- SheetJS CE 0.20.3: https://docs.sheetjs.com/docs/getting-started/installation/standalone/ (SheetJS-LICENSE)
- Supabase JS 2.118.0: https://github.com/supabase/supabase-js (Supabase-LICENSE)
- JSZip, Mammoth and Tesseract: original distribution license notices are retained in the script headers.

Tesseract downloads its worker/core/language resources on first use. Synthetic OCR is included in the browser test suite.
